Print & assembly

Test one joint

Print one panel and saddle first. Tune seat clearance before printing the full set. Changes to geometry, spacing or staggering require matching parts.

Slice supports together

Keep supported STL shells in their original positions. Inspect the layer preview before disabling slicer supports. Tune the contact gap for your material and layer height.

Assemble from the hub

Align roots, loosely fit the front clamp, then add rings at the exported offsets. Fit numbered saddles from behind: two bolts within a ring, four between rings. Tighten gradually with washers.

Check the interface

Keyed hub: 60 mm bolt circle. Legacy: 40 mm. Both use four M4 mount holes. Feeds, finishes and mount adapters are separate.

Read the dimensions

Shell thickness is vertical. Faceted backs add material; seats remove 0.35 mm locally. CAD volume is not filament usage; grip lengths exclude washers, nuts and thread engagement.

Geometry checked; physical fit and strength need testing. The ZIP includes the full assembly guide and hardware list.
